comingLast.roast: nearly all home - 18 survives as the low, and he cannot escape now
in on a 1-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
his lead over Jones is 1 - a strong gust could move it
safe by 3 unless the course gets generous late
finished 4 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
in on a 4-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
finished 4 above Jones - close enough to keep his speech drafted
5 points clear from the bar - watching Jones like a hawk with a beer
done and 5 above the drop - his interest in Jones's round is intense and personal
in the clubhouse 5 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
